title: Casa al Mare | KEY.co
description_expanded: Just a three-minute stroll from the sugar-white sands of Seagrove Beach, this newly built coastal retreat blends refined design with effortless relaxation. Light-filled interiors showcase shiplap accents, warm wood flooring, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that frame views of the private resort-style pool and spa. The open-concept living space features a modern gas fireplace and flows seamlessly into a chef’s kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances and a six-burner gas range. Outdoor living is equally inviting, with a covered porch, grill, and a second-floor deck overlooking the pool—an ideal setting for sun-soaked afternoons and relaxed evenings under the coastal sky. Thoughtfully designed to accommodate large gatherings, the home comfortably sleeps up to 24 with spacious king suites, flexible bunk accommodations, and a private pool house game room with additional sleeping. A Peloton adds a wellness touch, while the resort-style pool and spa create a private oasis for lounging and entertaining. Complimentary beach setups, six bikes, and a six-seater golf cart make exploring the nearby shoreline and charming Seagrove community effortless. Every detail of this elegant coastal escape is curated to deliver a luxurious, memorable stay along the Gulf Coast.
